title: Record the source indices of a rounded target window
body:
## Summary
- For denominators 2 through 20 and numerators strictly between the denominator and its double, every target window with endpoints at most 13 pulls back to the published ceiling interval.
- The check covers 17,290 windows and uses only integer arithmetic. The rounding is nondecreasing on each scanned range.
- The selected κ is unchanged.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/source-window-index/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/source-window-index/test_verify.py`
